WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        antenna_stat,
        netLatency_ms,
        radioSignal_dBm
    FROM Communication
    WHERE antenna_stat IS NOT NULL
      AND netLatency_ms IS NOT NULL
      AND radioSignal_dBm IS NOT NULL
),
cri_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        antenna_stat,
        netLatency_ms,
        radioSignal_dBm,
        CASE 
            WHEN antenna_stat = 'Error' THEN 0
            WHEN antenna_stat = 'Warning' THEN 5
            WHEN antenna_stat = 'Normal' THEN 10
            ELSE 0
        END * (1 - netLatency_ms / 1000.0) AS cri
    FROM filtered
),
bscsi_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        antenna_stat,
        cri * (1 + 0.2 * radioSignal_dBm / 100.0) * (1 - 0.01 * (1000 - netLatency_ms)) AS bscsi
    FROM cri_calc
)
SELECT 
    antenna_stat,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(bscsi AS numeric)), 4) AS avg_stability,
    COUNT(*) AS link_count
FROM bscsi_calc
GROUP BY antenna_stat
ORDER BY antenna_stat;
